definitions.explanation: Someone who has reached a high level of proficiency in a skill, sport, language, or other area.

examples.japanese: {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}けのクラスに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I joined the class for advanced students.

examples.japanese: この{山|やま}は{上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}でないと{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: This mountain is dangerous unless you're an experienced climber.

examples.japanese: {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}でも{苦戦|くせん}するほどの{難|むずか}しいコースだった。
examples.english: It was such a difficult course that even advanced practitioners struggled.

notes:
A compound of {上級|じょうきゅう} (advanced level) + {者|しゃ} (person).

LEVEL SERIES:
Part of a standard three-level proficiency series:
- {初級者|しょきゅうしゃ}: beginner
- {中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}: intermediate
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}: advanced

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け: aimed at advanced learners/users
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}けのコース: advanced-level course
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}でも{難|むずか}しい: difficult even for advanced people

USAGE:
Used for language learning, sports, skiing/snowboarding, martial arts, games, and any skill-based activity with graded levels.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと}: skilled person (more casual)
- {熟練者|じゅくれんしゃ}: expert, skilled practitioner (more formal)
- {達人|たつじん}: master, expert (stronger)
